title: EDSEA - WAS IT WORTH IT?!?
description:
EDC's EDSea's maiden voyage barely docked and they announced the dates for the second EDSea cruise planned for November 2-6, 2024.

People considering the second want to know, "Was it worth it?" 

This video gives you a tour of the boat, the stages, talks on topics from security to buying perks, my opinion, and interviews from other ravers about their thoughts on the matter.
